observation_level_result.meaning: Using only stored observation-period dates and the frozen engine minimum of 8 observations per eligible series, all 8 currencies have at least one eligible Growth series and one eligible Labour series by June 2020.
observation_level_result.warning: This is NOT yet the backtest start date. Official release lags and first-release/vintage availability must still be applied, which can move the true market-availability gate later.
